newsitem.title: GREECE: LEASING COMPANIES ALSO SUBJECT TO TAX LAW - FIN MIN.
newsitem.headline: LEASING COMPANIES ALSO SUBJECT TO TAX LAW - FIN MIN.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry dismissed requests by the Association of Leasing Companies, saying they could not be excluded from the tax law as they were found to be involved in fraudulent tax activities.

"As leasing companies were found implicated in transactions involving fake or forged tax details it is not possible that they be excluded as their association is demanding," the finance ministry said in a statement.

As per article 10, law 2362/1995 finance ministry services are required to submit reports on their investigative activities on matters of contraband trade and tax evasion. The report must include tables which list all violators of tax and customs laws, it said.

"The ministry's services thus acted based on facts available to them that had as a sole criterion the committed violation, not the nature of business activity," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
